# OMNIVOX

> UK/EU cloud contact centre for outbound sales and inbound voice. Preview, progressive and power dial, inbound queues and IVR, custom wallboards. £25 a seat, prepaid minutes, no fair-use fiction.

OMNIVOX is operated by Quanterae Solutions. Platform fee £25 per agent per month. Telephony is prepaid at approximately 5p per connected minute, inbound and outbound, one wallet, one-minute minimum. Usage is visible in Admin → Call Credits.

## Product facts

- Live dial methods: manual / click-to-call, preview, progressive (1:1), power (ratio > 1, AMD-gated)
- Twilio AMD is live. Adaptive Power and statistical predictive are waitlist only — predictive is not shipped
- Custom wallboards are first-class: builder, TV mode, playlists, ~40 widgets
- Inbound is a contact-centre stack: platform-managed UK numbers, queues, hours, visual IVR
- One prepaid credit wallet covers inbound and outbound
- No BYOC / multi-carrier — we run Twilio
- Call recording is configurable per organisation or campaign; consent is the customer’s job
- UK GDPR: the customer is the data controller; OMNIVOX is the data processor
- A Data Processing Agreement is provided at onboarding
- Not omnichannel. Not a conversational-AI platform
- Contact: hello@omnivox.co.uk
- App login: https://omnivox-ai.vercel.app/login
